thirdPartyStaticCheck.actualPreservation: The two Three build files retain original @license/MIT/three.js-authors headers. The three upstream example modules have no individual copyright header in the pinned bytes, but the unchanged directory MIT license accompanies all five modules. RiggedSimple has its unchanged model license and Cesium 2017 CC-BY-4.0 metadata, plus a local attribution statement and link. No missing license/attribution bundle was observed in this fixed research sample.
thirdPartyStaticCheck.limitation: This is static evidence of existing bytes and notices, not legal advice or an exhaustive redistribution-compliance/originality review. A repository-wide first-party license must not overwrite these third-party terms.

identityAndLicensing.note: White Egret/egret-style API, @egret/* package identities and the local egret-core-framework-prototype name are separate decisions from the public repository name, GitHub owner, domain, brand rights and npm publication authorization. private=true blocks npm publication; it does not prohibit a public Git source repository.
identityAndLicensing.requiredDisclosure: Until a first-party software/document license is selected, say public/source-release candidate or planned open-source project; do not claim the whole repository is already OSI-licensed. Keep Three MIT and RiggedSimple CC-BY-4.0 ownership/terms independently visible.
